text: The policyholder returned from a weekend away and found water damage in the kitchen. A plumber identified a burst pipe beneath the sink. Photos and a repair estimate have been provided.

The policyholder reports that another vehicle struck the rear of their car while they were stopped at a traffic light. They provided photographs of the damage and the other driver's registration details.
The policyholder reports that a laptop was stolen from their home while they were away. There are signs of forced entry and the incident has been reported to the police.
The policyholder's flight was cancelled and they purchased a replacement flight for the following morning. They submitted the cancellation notice and receipts for the replacement travel.
The policyholder reports discovering damage to the side of their parked car after returning from a supermarket. They do not know who caused it and have submitted photographs of the damage.
The policyholder reports water damage to a ceiling following a leak from the bathroom above. A contractor confirmed a failed pipe connection and supplied an estimate for repairs.
